scenarios.hypothesis_summary: two people arrived in a light-coloured van in the service lane, forced the stockroom west window person with the tool a pry bar, and one climbed inside while the other remained at the sill. The inside intruder took boxed drills from the racking, entered the office, searched the filing cabinet, opened the safe and took the cash float, passing boxes out through the window for loading into the van before both left. Tobias had locked the customer door earlier and Mr Emeka Halloran later entered as keyholder and found the safe empty.

supporting_facts.text: CCTV recorded two people in dark clothing getting out of a light-coloured van and walking towards the west wall, one carrying a long object.
The stockroom window was prised open, its lock keep torn from the frame, and a pry bar was left under it.
person with the tool climbed through the window feet first while the other stayed outside at the sill.
Alarm sensors recorded stockroom and office motion and the safe door opening in sequence.
Boxes were handed through the window, carried to the van, and the inside person later climbed out before the van left.
Approximately 20 boxed drills and the cash float were reported taken; the safe was found open and empty and two sets of footwear marks were found.

The identities and faces of the two people from the van were not seen or recorded.
